keywords.keyword: talk to my agents more than my team

drafts.text:
greg runs 50+ people in 12 countries and talks to his agents more than his team.

a 20-room amsterdam boutique hotel has six people and no night desk.

one company brain that knows the rooms, rates and every review answers the 2am guest so the team can host.
drafts.rides: gregisenberg 'running a company nowadays feels kinda dystopian. my team is 50+ people in 12 countries, but i talk to my agents more than my human teammates' (362.6K, 9,816 bookmarks) + greg boring-business agents (146.4K, 2,987 bookmarks)

drafts.text:
min's agent booked a doctor's appointment while he was driving.

most amsterdam boutique hotels have no one on at 1am. a guest asks about late check-in, nobody answers, they book somewhere else.

an agent that answers wins that night back as a direct booking.
drafts.rides: minchoi 'Grok Bot just made a doctor's appointment for me while I was driving' (1.57M views, 179 bookmarks) + dhh 'Have you said thank you to your agent today?' (126.6K)

drafts.text:
levelsio serves 20,000 paying customers on ~$300/mo in biz costs.

amsterdam boutique hotels leak margin on jobs nobody was hired for: late replies, review answers, rate checks.

so i read their public reviews, find the leak and ship a working sample before any call.
drafts.rides: levelsio 'My total biz expenses have now dropped to just ~$300/mo' for 20,000 paying customers (273.6K, 3,183 bookmarks) + gregisenberg 'no one wants AI powered products' (53.7K)

video_tip: Video tip: 30s vertical screen recording. Start with a voice note to the agent ('guest asks if they can check in at 1am'), cut to the hotel's company brain answering from the house rules and reviews, end on 'the night desk you never hired'. greg's text post listing his voice-note-to-agent workflow is the most-saved watchlist post in the window (362.6K views, 9,816 bookmarks) and his boring-business agents video reached 146.4K / 2,987 bookmarks, so show the workflow, don't explain it.
